lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A roughly rectangular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least four identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with spacing narrowing slightly towards the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regularized checkerboard-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges extending along the upper two-thirds of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from high-intensity upper edges to lower-intensity shadow zones.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Visible distribution of approximately 5-7 distinct high-luminance blobs of varying diameters localized within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-reflectance elongated object, consistent with a commensal remora, positioned immediately ventral to the left pectoral fin.
